s0101.literal: Now we your ministers have deliberated: among the imperial kin, the only one who was able to extricate himself from the rebel faction and devote himself loyally to the court is Buyan; we request he be further enfeoffed and rewarded, to show encouragement.
s0101.idiomatic: Now we your ministers have deliberated: among the imperial kin, the only one who was able to extricate himself from the rebel faction and devote himself loyally to the court is Buyan; we request he be further enfeoffed and rewarded, to show encouragement.

s0102.literal: " Accordingly, five thousand households of Taining County were granted to enfeoff Buyan as Prince of Taining.
s0102.idiomatic: Accordingly, 5,000 households of Taining County were granted to enfeoff Buyan as Prince of Taining.

s0103.literal: Kuochebo, privy council director and grand master of the imperial clan, was granted Grand Preceptor of the State with ceremonial honors equal to the Three Excellencies; the former grand preceptor Baihu was appointed to deliberate on weighty state and military affairs.
s0103.idiomatic: Kuochebo, privy council director and grand master of the imperial clan, was granted Grand Preceptor of the State with ceremonial honors equal to the Three Excellencies; the former grand preceptor Baihu was appointed to deliberate on weighty state and military affairs.

s0104.literal: On dinghai day rewards for suppressing the rebellion were deliberated; Xumaijie was granted ten ingots of gold, thirty ingots of silver, and seven thousand ingots of notes; Dilqash was made left chancellor of the central secretariat; privy council director Ma'asha, censor-in-chief Niuzhe, and Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner Suotu were all additionally granted the title Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and gold, silver, and notes were granted in varying amounts.
s0104.idiomatic: On dinghai day rewards for suppressing the rebellion were deliberated; Xumaijie was granted 10 ingots of gold, 30 ingots of silver, and 7,000 ingots of notes; Dilqash was made left chancellor of the central secretariat; privy council director Ma'asha, censor-in-chief Niuzhe, and Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner Suotu were all additionally granted the title Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, and gold, silver, and notes were granted in varying amounts.

s0105.literal: A statue of the Buddha Mahakala was cast at Huiqing Pavilion of Extended Spring Pavilion.
s0105.idiomatic: A statue of the Buddha Mahakala was cast at Huiqing Pavilion of Extended Spring Pavilion.

s0106.literal: An edict changing the reign era was issued, reading: "We have received Heaven's great blessing, succeeded to the great imperial succession, and turn Our person to seek good governance, reverently vigilant day and night, following only our ancestral instructions; now at the opening year jiazi, as a splendid fortune begins, We wish to renew all under Heaven.
s0106.idiomatic: An edict changing the reign era was issued, reading, "We have received Heaven's great blessing, succeeded to the great imperial succession, and turn Our person to seek good governance, reverently vigilant day and night, following only our ancestral instructions; now at the opening year jiazi, as a splendid fortune begins, We wish to renew all under Heaven.

s0107.literal: Checking against canonical ritual, changing the reign title after a year has passed — next year may be made the first year of Taiding.
s0107.idiomatic: Checking against canonical ritual, changing the reign title after a year has passed — next year may be made the first year of Taiding.

s0108.literal: " Corvée and tax levies were remitted for three years in the capital and Xinghe; for one year in the Bafan, Si, Bo, and Two Guang cave stockades; the newly imposed package silver levy in Jiang-Huai for three years; one-third of autumn grain in Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu; and one-third of silk and notes in Henan, Shaanxi, and Liaoyang.
s0108.idiomatic: Corvée and tax levies were remitted for 3 years in the capital and Xinghe; for 1 year in the Bafan, Si, Bo, and Two Guang cave stockades; the newly imposed package silver levy in Jiang-Huai for 3 years; one-third of autumn grain in Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu; and one-third of silk and notes in Henan, Shaanxi, and Liaoyang.

s0109.literal: Inflated land taxes were abolished; arrears owed to otog offices were remitted; and garrison troops in Yunnan, Guang-Hai, Bafan, and other places were relieved and comforted.
s0109.idiomatic: Inflated land taxes were abolished; arrears owed to otog offices were remitted; and garrison troops in Yunnan, Guang-Hai, Bafan, and other places were relieved and comforted.

s0110.literal: Candid remonstrance was sought; silks were granted to the aged; and the presentation of profits from mountain preserves and lakes was forbidden.
s0110.idiomatic: Candid remonstrance was sought; silks were granted to the aged; and the presentation of profits from mountain preserves and lakes was forbidden.

s0111.literal: It was fixed that those entering service as clerical officials should rank at regular fourth grade.
s0111.idiomatic: It was fixed that those entering service as clerical officials should rank at regular fourth grade.

s0112.literal: An edict was issued throughout the realm to posthumously honor Our late father and mother.
s0112.idiomatic: An edict was issued throughout the realm to posthumously honor Our late father and mother.

s0113.literal: The Huajiao tribesmen of Yunnan became bandits; an edict was issued to summon and instruct them.
s0113.idiomatic: The Huajiao tribesmen of Yunnan became bandits; an edict was issued to summon and instruct them.

s0114.literal: Jiading Prefecture in Pingjiang suffered famine; Dayangshi tribesmen and Kuokuo Department in Liaoyang suffered wind and hail damage — all were relieved.
s0114.idiomatic: Jiading Prefecture in Pingjiang suffered famine; Dayangshi tribesmen and Kuokuo Department in Liaoyang suffered wind and hail damage — all were relieved.

s0115.literal: Li Prefecture and Gui Prefecture suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of grain were sold at relief prices.
s0115.idiomatic: Li Prefecture and Gui Prefecture suffered famine; 20,000 shi of grain were sold at relief prices.

s0116.literal: That year, in summer, garrison farms of the various guards and subordinate counties of Dadu and the five circuits of Hejian, Baoding, Jinan, and Jining suffered crop damage from incessant rain.
s0116.idiomatic: That year, in summer, garrison farms of the various guards and subordinate counties of Dadu and the five circuits of Hejian, Baoding, Jinan, and Jining suffered crop damage from incessant rain.

s0117.literal: In autumn, Dingxiang County of Xin Prefecture and fields managed by the Zhongyi Guard garrison farm office and the Xiangshi garrison farm office were killed by frost.
s0117.idiomatic: In autumn, Dingxiang County of Xin Prefecture and fields managed by the Zhongyi Guard garrison farm office and the Xiangshi garrison farm office were killed by frost.

s0118.literal: Tubo of Min Prefecture suffered plague in spring and drought in summer.
s0118.idiomatic: Tubo of Min Prefecture suffered plague in spring and drought in summer.

s0120.literal: First year of Taiding, spring, first month, on yiwei day Namatai was made grand councillor and Shanseng right vice chancellor.
s0120.idiomatic: First year of Taiding, spring, first month, on yiwei day Namatai was made grand councillor and Shanseng right vice chancellor.

s0121.literal: Princes Hala were ordered back to their departments; Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Ye'erjini was summoned to court.
s0121.idiomatic: Princes Hala were ordered back to their departments; Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Ye'erjini was summoned to court.

s0122.literal: On jihai day an edict was issued throughout the realm on the execution of the rebel ministers Yeshi Temür and others.
s0122.idiomatic: On jihai day an edict was issued throughout the realm on the execution of the rebel ministers Yeshi Temür and others.

s0123.literal: On xinchou day princes and great ministers requested the establishment of a crown prince.
s0123.idiomatic: On xinchou day princes and great ministers requested the establishment of a crown prince.

s0124.literal: Prince Chechetut was granted one ingot of gold, sixty ingots of silver, and one hundred bolts each of silks and cloths; Tasibuhua was granted one ingot of gold, forty ingots of silver, and two hundred bolts of silks and cloths; Ahu Temür and others received gold and silver in varying amounts.
s0124.idiomatic: Prince Chechetut was granted 1 ingot of gold, 60 ingots of silver, and 100 bolts each of silks and cloths; Tasibuhua was granted 1 ingot of gold, 40 ingots of silver, and 200 bolts of silks and cloths; Ahu Temür and others received gold and silver in varying amounts.

s0125.literal: On renyin day the late chancellor Baizhu's son Darimasi was made Zongren Guard personal guard army commander-in-chief, and Chiriqa was made Left and Right Guard Ashig command elite army commander-in-chief.
s0125.idiomatic: On renyin day the late chancellor Baizhu's son Darimasi was made Zongren Guard personal guard army commander-in-chief, and Chiriqa was made Left and Right Guard Ashig command elite army commander-in-chief.

s0126.literal: Monks were ordered to recite Western scriptures at Bright Heaven Hall.
s0126.idiomatic: Monks were ordered to recite Western scriptures at Bright Heaven Hall.

s0127.literal: On jiachen day orders were issued to translate The Reign Edicts of Successive Sovereigns and The Comprehensive Regulations of the Great Yuan, print editions, and grant them to the hundred officials.
s0127.idiomatic: On jiachen day orders were issued to translate The Reign Edicts of Successive Sovereigns and The Comprehensive Regulations of the Great Yuan, print editions, and grant them to the hundred officials.

s0128.literal: On dingwei day Tiecen, darughachi of the Chenghai garrison-farm wanhu office, was temporarily appointed associate administrator of the Lingbei branch central secretariat; close attendant Hutu Temür was temporarily appointed Minister of Rites and sent to the department of the Western Regions prince Busain.
s0128.idiomatic: On dingwei day Tiecen, darughachi of the Chenghai garrison-farm wanhu office, was temporarily appointed associate administrator of the Lingbei branch central secretariat; close attendant Hutu Temür was temporarily appointed Minister of Rites and sent to the department of the Western Regions prince Busain.

s0129.literal: On wushen day the Bafan Shengman Wei Guangzheng and others and people of five Yang and Huang groups came to submit with twenty-seven thousand households, requesting to pay twenty-five hundred bolts of cloth annually; a native official office was established to pacify them.
s0129.idiomatic: On wushen day the Bafan Shengman Wei Guangzheng and others and people of five Yang and Huang groups came to submit with 27,000 households, requesting to pay 2,500 bolts of cloth annually; a native official office was established to pacify them.

s0130.literal: On jiyou day all princes who had been exiled far away were ordered to return to their departments.
s0130.idiomatic: On jiyou day all princes who had been exiled far away were ordered to return to their departments.

s0131.literal: Imperial prince Tutumur was summoned from Qiong Prefecture and Amuge from Datong.
s0131.idiomatic: Imperial prince Tutumur was summoned from Qiong Prefecture and Amuge from Datong.

s0132.literal: It was fixed that the Keshik platform's annual grant of notes would be eighty ingots per person.
s0132.idiomatic: It was fixed that the Keshik platform's annual grant of notes would be 80 ingots per person.

s0133.literal: On jiayin day princes Taiping, Hulatai, Besh Temür, and others were granted gold seals.
s0133.idiomatic: On jiayin day princes Taiping, Hulatai, Besh Temür, and others were granted gold seals.

s0134.literal: The King of Goryeo was ordered to return to his country, and his seal was returned to him.
s0134.idiomatic: The King of Goryeo was ordered to return to his country, and his seal was returned to him.

s0135.literal: Two hundred thousand shi of grain were sold at relief prices to relieve the capital's impoverished people.
s0135.idiomatic: 200,000 shi of grain were sold at relief prices to relieve the capital's impoverished people.

s0136.literal: On bingchen day the wives and children of the late investigating censors Guanyinbao and Sao'er Hademishi were each granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0136.idiomatic: On bingchen day the wives and children of the late investigating censors Guanyinbao and Sao'er Hademishi were each granted 1,000 ingots of notes.

s0137.literal: Grand master of the imperial clan Daozhu was granted a seal.
s0137.idiomatic: Grand master of the imperial clan Daozhu was granted a seal.

s0138.literal: Orders were issued to ennoble the salt pond god of Xie Prefecture as Lord Lingfu.
s0138.idiomatic: Orders were issued to ennoble the salt pond god of Xie Prefecture as Lord Lingfu.

s0139.literal: The people of Guangde, Xin, Yue, Huizhou, and Nan'en prefectures suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0139.idiomatic: The people of Guangde, Xin, Yue, Huizhou, and Nan'en prefectures suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

s0140.literal: Second month, on dingsi new moon, a spirit hall for Emperor Xianzong was constructed.
s0140.idiomatic: Second month, on dingsi new moon, a spirit hall for Emperor Xianzong was constructed.

s0141.literal: On jiwei day Western Buddhist rites were performed at Shou'an Mountain Temple — Singis Khira, Korluhbo, Suidorma, and Sanjemiranjia — with forty scripture-reciting monks; after three years the rite ceased.
s0141.idiomatic: On jiwei day Western Buddhist rites were performed at Shou'an Mountain Temple — Singis Khira, Korluhbo, Suidorma, and Sanjemiranjia — with 40 scripture-reciting monks; after 3 years the rite ceased.

s0142.literal: On gengshen day investigating censors Fu Yanqi and Li Jiabin said: "Prince of Liaoning Tuotuo, taking advantage of a breach in the state, slaughtered his kin; his wickedness is already manifest; we fear he harbors divided loyalties — if he is allowed to return to his fief, it is like releasing a tiger from its cage.
s0142.idiomatic: On gengshen day investigating censors Fu Yanqi and Li Jiabin said, "Prince of Liaoning Tuotuo, taking advantage of a breach in the state, slaughtered his kin; his wickedness is already manifest; we fear he harbors divided loyalties — if he is allowed to return to his fief, it is like releasing a tiger from its cage.

s0143.literal: We request he be deposed and a near kinsman be installed in his place to succeed to the position.
s0143.idiomatic: We request he be deposed and a near kinsman be installed in his place to succeed to the position.

s0145.literal: On jiazi day Buddhist rites were performed; one hundred eight monks and a hundred entertainers with various performances were ordered to lead the Imperial Preceptor in touring the capital city.
s0145.idiomatic: On jiazi day Buddhist rites were performed; 108 monks and 100 entertainers with various performances were ordered to lead the Imperial Preceptor in touring the capital city.

s0146.literal: On gengwu day prefectural and county administrators and pushing officials were selected.
s0146.idiomatic: On gengwu day prefectural and county administrators and pushing officials were selected.

s0147.literal: Under the old system, the censorate each year recommended two prefectural and county administrators and pushing officials, with collective punishment for offenses; now it was said this was inconvenient, and the central secretariat was again ordered to select and appoint persons from the regular candidate pool.
s0147.idiomatic: Under the old system, the censorate each year recommended two prefectural and county administrators and pushing officials, with collective punishment for offenses; now it was said this was inconvenient, and the central secretariat was again ordered to select and appoint persons from the regular candidate pool.

s0148.literal: On renshen day the posthumous title was presented at the Southern Suburb for the late emperor: Emperor Ruisheng Wenxiao, temple name Yingzong.
s0148.idiomatic: On renshen day the posthumous title was presented at the Southern Suburb for the late emperor: Emperor Ruisheng Wenxiao, temple name Yingzong.

s0149.literal: On jiaxu day Jiangzhe branch secretariat left vice director Zhao Jian requested opening the lecture hall and selecting tutors, directing the crown prince and sons and grandsons of princes and great ministers to receive instruction; accordingly grand councillor Zhang Gui, Hanlin academician-director Hutu Rudu'ermishi, academician Wu Cheng, and Hall of Worthies regular academician Deng Wenyuan were ordered to lecture on Models for Emperors, Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government, Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign, and other books; right chancellor Yeshi Temür was again ordered to oversee it.
s0149.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Jiangzhe branch secretariat left vice director Zhao Jian requested opening the lecture hall and selecting tutors, directing the crown prince and sons and grandsons of princes and great ministers to receive instruction; accordingly grand councillor Zhang Gui, Hanlin academician-director Hutu Rudu'ermishi, academician Wu Cheng, and Hall of Worthies regular academician Deng Wenyuan were ordered to lecture on Models for Emperors, Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government, Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, Essentials of Government from the Zhenguan Reign, and other books; right chancellor Yeshi Temür was again ordered to oversee it.

s0150.literal: Princes Kebie and Boluo each dispatched envoys presenting tribute.
s0150.idiomatic: Princes Kebie and Boluo each dispatched envoys presenting tribute.

s0151.literal: The Gaochang king and protector-general Temür Buhua dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.
s0151.idiomatic: The Gaochang king and protector-general Temür Buhua dispatched envoys presenting grape wine.

s0152.literal: On dingchou day investigating censors Song Ben, Zhao Chengqing, and Li Jiabin said: "The theft of the Imperial Ancestral Temple spirit tablets was due to the Grand Ceremonies Bureau's lax guarding; we request they be punished.
s0152.idiomatic: On dingchou day investigating censors Song Ben, Zhao Chengqing, and Li Jiabin said, "The theft of the Imperial Ancestral Temple spirit tablets was due to the Grand Ceremonies Bureau's lax guarding; we request they be punished.

s0154.literal: On wuyin day censor Li Jiabin impeached Left Ashig Guard commander Tietiemür, a member of the rebel faction; he was dismissed.
s0154.idiomatic: On wuyin day censor Li Jiabin impeached Left Ashig Guard commander Tietiemür, a member of the rebel faction; he was dismissed.

s0155.literal: On guiwei day Nestorian Christians were instructed each to observe the full precepts of their teaching.
s0155.idiomatic: On guiwei day Nestorian Christians were instructed each to observe the full precepts of their teaching.

s0156.literal: Lord Zhang Zhenjun of Cishan in Guangde Route was additionally ennobled as Puji; the Broad Grace King of Ningguo Route was additionally ennobled as Fuyou.
s0156.idiomatic: Lord Zhang Zhenjun of Cishan in Guangde Route was additionally ennobled as Puji; the Broad Grace King of Ningguo Route was additionally ennobled as Fuyou.

s0157.literal: Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Yan'an, Yue, and Chaozhou routes and Zhenyuan Prefecture, He Prefecture, and Ji Prefecture suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.
s0157.idiomatic: Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Yan'an, Yue, and Chaozhou routes and Zhenyuan Prefecture, He Prefecture, and Ji Prefecture suffered famine; grain was issued for relief.

s0158.literal: Third month, on dinghai new moon, the Huizheng Court was abolished and the Household of the Heir Apparent was established; grand preceptor Duotai, Bureau of Imperial Entertainments commissioner Tudmandier, Duke Huan of the State Shiderlu, and grand marshal Chiludarhan were all made household officials for the crown prince;
s0158.idiomatic: Third month, on dinghai new moon, the Huizheng Court was abolished and the Household of the Heir Apparent was established; grand preceptor Duotai, Bureau of Imperial Entertainments commissioner Tudmandier, Duke Huan of the State Shiderlu, and grand marshal Chiludarhan were all made household officials for the crown prince;

s0159.literal: central secretariat associate administrator Wang Juren was made deputy household official for the crown prince; Bureau of Buddhist Affairs associate commissioner Yang Tingyu was made central secretariat associate administrator; garrison farms at Huanghua Ridge and Chongqing in Datong Route were abolished.
s0159.idiomatic: central secretariat associate administrator Wang Juren was made deputy household official for the crown prince; Bureau of Buddhist Affairs associate commissioner Yang Tingyu was made central secretariat associate administrator; garrison farms at Huanghua Ridge and Chongqing in Datong Route were abolished.

s0160.literal: Princess Shouning was granted ten ingots of gold, fifty ingots of silver, and twenty thousand ingots of notes.
s0160.idiomatic: Princess Shouning was granted 10 ingots of gold, 50 ingots of silver, and 20,000 ingots of notes.

s0161.literal: On yiwei day Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Ye'erjini was made privy council director.
s0161.idiomatic: On yiwei day Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Ye'erjini was made privy council director.

s0162.literal: The Prince of Ding Xie Chegan Superintendent's Office was established.
s0162.idiomatic: The Prince of Ding Xie Chegan Superintendent's Office was established.

s0163.literal: Grain and notes were granted to displaced Mongols and they were sent back to their departments; unauthorized migrants were ordered executed and concealers beaten.
s0163.idiomatic: Grain and notes were granted to displaced Mongols and they were sent back to their departments; unauthorized migrants were ordered executed and concealers beaten.

s0164.literal: Prince Chechetut was granted thirteen thousand six hundred households of Yongfu County as a fief for sustenance; a prince tutor was also established.
s0164.idiomatic: Prince Chechetut was granted 13,600 households of Yongfu County as a fief for sustenance; a prince tutor was also established.

s0165.literal: On wuxu day palace examination graduates were tested; Bala, Zhang Yi, and eighty-four others were granted jinshi degrees and official entry in varying grades;
s0165.idiomatic: On wuxu day palace examination graduates were tested; Bala, Zhang Yi, and 84 others were granted jinshi degrees and official entry in varying grades;

s0166.literal: those who failed the metropolitan examination were also granted instructor posts in varying grades.
s0166.idiomatic: those who failed the metropolitan examination were also granted instructor posts in varying grades.

s0167.literal: Central secretariat officials requested prohibition of unauthorized memorials requesting rewards and of memorializing beyond one's jurisdiction; this was approved.
s0167.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials requested prohibition of unauthorized memorials requesting rewards and of memorializing beyond one's jurisdiction; this was approved.

s0168.literal: On gengzi day Qincha was dismissed and made Shaanxi Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.
s0168.idiomatic: On gengzi day Qincha was dismissed and made Shaanxi Branch Censorate censor-in-chief.

s0169.literal: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Nangjiatai was additionally made Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner and sent to campaign against Western tribes raiding Canbulang.
s0169.idiomatic: Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Nangjiatai was additionally made Bureau of Buddhist Affairs commissioner and sent to campaign against Western tribes raiding Canbulang.

s0170.literal: On guimao day central secretariat grand councillor Namatai was ordered to perform sacrificial duties at the Southern Suburb by proxy, and privy council director Kuochebo to perform sacrificial duties at the Imperial Ancestral Temple by proxy, to announce the investiture of the empress and crown prince.
s0170.idiomatic: On guimao day central secretariat grand councillor Namatai was ordered to perform sacrificial duties at the Southern Suburb by proxy, and privy council director Kuochebo to perform sacrificial duties at the Imperial Ancestral Temple by proxy, to announce the investiture of the empress and crown prince.

s0171.literal: On bingwu day at Bright Great Hall, Lady Babahan was invested as empress and the prince Ashigbah as crown prince.
s0171.idiomatic: On bingwu day at Bright Great Hall, Lady Babahan was invested as empress and the prince Ashigbah as crown prince.

s0172.literal: On jiyou day Prince Baidimayier Jianbu succeeded to the enfeoffment as Prince of Jin.
s0172.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince Baidimayier Jianbu succeeded to the enfeoffment as Prince of Jin.

s0173.literal: Prince of Taining Buyan died; his son Yilianzhen Duorzhi succeeded.
s0173.idiomatic: Prince of Taining Buyan died; his son Yilianzhen Duorzhi succeeded.

s0174.literal: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was dispatched to take up defense at Chaghan Na'ur; the pacification commission was abolished and a prince tutor's office was established.
s0174.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was dispatched to take up defense at Chaghan Na'ur; the pacification commission was abolished and a prince tutor's office was established.

s0175.literal: Privy council director Ye'erjini was made Yunnan branch secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0175.idiomatic: Privy council director Ye'erjini was made Yunnan branch secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0176.literal: Exiles were summoned back to the capital.
s0176.idiomatic: Exiles were summoned back to the capital.

s0177.literal: On gengxu day Yuezhiyan tribesmen Zhenzhihai and Adahan came to present large pearls.
s0177.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yuezhiyan tribesmen Zhenzhihai and Adahan came to present large pearls.

s0178.literal: Investigating censors Song Ben, Li Jiabin, and Fu Yanqi said: "Grand marshal, grand master of the imperial clan, and minister of works — the Three Excellencies — are recklessly lent to Buddhist monks, and the Huifu and Shuxiang two courts likewise disgrace nominal honors; we request they be abolished.
s0178.idiomatic: Investigating censors Song Ben, Li Jiabin, and Fu Yanqi said, "Grand marshal, grand master of the imperial clan, and minister of works — the Three Excellencies — are recklessly lent to Buddhist monks, and the Huifu and Shuxiang two courts likewise disgrace nominal honors; we request they be abolished.

s0180.literal: On guichou day Prince Busain dispatched envoys for court audience and tribute.
s0180.idiomatic: On guichou day Prince Busain dispatched envoys for court audience and tribute.

s0181.literal: Dida County of Lintao, Shi Prefecture of Jining, and Lishi and Ningxiang counties suffered drought and famine; grain was granted for relief for two months.
s0181.idiomatic: Dida County of Lintao, Shi Prefecture of Jining, and Lishi and Ningxiang counties suffered drought and famine; grain was granted for relief for 2 months.

s0182.literal: Yao tribesmen of Heng Prefecture in Guangxi raided Yongchun County.
s0182.idiomatic: Yao tribesmen of Heng Prefecture in Guangxi raided Yongchun County.

s0183.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuwu day Lian Xun was dismissed and made Hall of Worthies grand academician, receiving salary for life.
s0183.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on wuwu day Lian Xun was dismissed and made Hall of Worthies grand academician, receiving salary for life.

s0184.literal: The wet nurse Lady Li was granted one thousand ingots of notes; troops campaigning against Canbulang — one thousand men — were granted forty-seven thousand ingots of notes.
s0184.idiomatic: The wet nurse Lady Li was granted 1,000 ingots of notes; troops campaigning against Canbulang — 1,000 men — were granted 47,000 ingots of notes.

s0185.literal: Grand marshal Buhua and grand councillor Jilie, for forging an edict to forcibly marry the widow Guha to Sati, were interrogated; an edict pardoned their crime because they were old subjects of Kublai.
s0185.idiomatic: Grand marshal Buhua and grand councillor Jilie, for forging an edict to forcibly marry the widow Guha to Sati, were interrogated; an edict pardoned their crime because they were old subjects of Kublai.

s0186.literal: On jiwei day an edict written in pearl script granted the Sasija department where the Imperial Preceptor resided.
s0186.idiomatic: On jiwei day an edict written in pearl script granted the Sasija department where the Imperial Preceptor resided.

s0187.literal: On gengshen day an edict ordered the censorate to be rectified and disciplined.
s0187.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered the censorate to be rectified and disciplined.

s0188.literal: A portrait hall for Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng was constructed at Puji Temple.
s0188.idiomatic: A portrait hall for Empress Zhaoxian Yuansheng was constructed at Puji Temple.

s0189.literal: On xinyou day Prince of Chang Bala Temür was ordered to take up defense at the place where Ananda formerly resided.
s0189.idiomatic: On xinyou day Prince of Chang Bala Temür was ordered to take up defense at the place where Ananda formerly resided.

s0190.literal: Imperial prince Tutumur arrived from Tan Prefecture, and Prince Wangshan — both were granted carriages, tents, and camels.
s0190.idiomatic: Imperial prince Tutumur arrived from Tan Prefecture, and Prince Wangshan — both were granted carriages, tents, and camels.

s0191.literal: On guihai day in the national language the temple name of Emperor Yingzong was presented as Emperor Gejian.
s0191.idiomatic: On guihai day in the national language the temple name of Emperor Yingzong was presented as Emperor Gejian.

s0192.literal: Buddhist rites were performed at Longevity Splendor Hall.
s0192.idiomatic: Buddhist rites were performed at Longevity Splendor Hall.

s0193.literal: On jiazi day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.
s0193.idiomatic: On jiazi day the imperial carriage visited the Upper Capital.

s0194.literal: Princes Kanchibuhua and Shila, grand councillor Ubador, right vice chancellor Shanseng, and others were left to guard.
s0194.idiomatic: Princes Kanchibuhua and Shila, grand councillor Ubador, right vice chancellor Shanseng, and others were left to guard.

s0195.literal: Lingbei branch secretariat left vice director Popi was made central secretariat left vice director; Jiangnan branch censorate vice director Duoduo was made central secretariat associate administrator; Mara was dismissed and made Astronomical Bureau commissioner; four hundred guard soldiers were dismissed and returned to the Zongren Guard.
s0195.idiomatic: Lingbei branch secretariat left vice director Popi was made central secretariat left vice director; Jiangnan branch censorate vice director Duoduo was made central secretariat associate administrator; Mara was dismissed and made Astronomical Bureau commissioner; 400 guard soldiers were dismissed and returned to the Zongren Guard.

s0196.literal: Sheep and horses were granted to the Beiting Disa'er Ulug army.
s0196.idiomatic: Sheep and horses were granted to the Beiting Disa'er Ulug army.

s0197.literal: Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting tribute.
s0197.idiomatic: Prince Busain dispatched envoys presenting tribute.

s0199.literal: On bingyin day Prince of Chang Bala Temür was granted cattle, horses, and camels.
